purpose: Forty-eight separately illustrated hairstyles and their turnarounds for Hero Showdown Royale. Bald uses the uncovered head. Default standing hairstyles preserve the uploaded character references.
method: Illustrated transparent sprite sheets generated with imagegen and registered against the original Style C face anchors. Losslessly packed neutral color materials preserve ink and skin-independent recoloring. Saturated metallic cuffs keep their own color.
sourcePrompt: PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE ATLAS. Use the attached hero images exclusively as drawing-style references. Produce ONE polished transparent PNG, landscape 4:3, containing exactly 12 separate illustrated HAIRPIECES ONLY (four columns, three rows). It is a regular contact sheet of a professional dress-up RPG paper-doll animation system. Column 1 is {1}. Column 2 is {2}. Column 3 is {3}. Column 4 is {4}. IMPORTANT the three images in each column are the SAME hairstyle seen in three DIRECTIONS. Row 1: looking straight at camera, front hairline. Row 2: three-quarter side view turned toward the RIGHT of the canvas, hairline shifted right. Row 3: strict REAR view of the same style from behind, full solid back of hair. The hair is hovering on a completely INVISIBLE mannequin: absolutely NO faces, no eyes, no eyebrows, no ears, no scalp skin, no necks, no bodies, no mannequin base. Transparent opening where the front face normally shows, never fill with any color or skin. Colored hair areas only. Each sprite centers inside an equal 4-column by 3-row cell, clear gutters and generous alpha padding. All hairstyles rendered in deep neutral cocoa charcoal/brown with bold clean near-black outlines, rich warm top-left cel highlights, refined strand texture matching attached chibi superhero. Each hairstyle is individual, polished, and usable. Even lighting across rows. For braids or locs optional sparse gold cuff accents. NO cast shadows, NO glows, no visible grid, NO text labels, NO numbers, NO background, NO unrelated objects. Large and crisp.
